in_marathi.name: Trishan
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of three worlds
in_marathi.long_meaning: Trishan हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Trishan is a Sanskrit name, derived from the word 'Trivishat,' which means 'Lord of the three worlds.' In Hindu mythology, Trishan is the name of the three-headed god, Brahma, who is the creator of the universe.
